in_hebrew.name: ויקי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Viki is derived from the Hebrew word יקי (Yiqi), which means 'my god is he'. This name expresses faith and devotion to God.

in_greek.name: Βίκιος
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Viki is derived from the Greek word Βίκιος (Bikios), which means 'son of victory'. This name celebrates the victories and triumphs won through God's strength and power.

in_latin.name: Victus
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Viki is derived from the Latin word Victus, which means 'conquered' or 'victor'. This name reflects the idea of overcoming challenges and achieving victory through God's strength and guidance.
